title: Implement a Contact Centre as a Service
context: We use a legacy application, on-prem, unsupported that cover VOIP.
problem: It doesn't support where the business needs to be
proposal: We want to implement a full CCaaS platform that covers all digital platforms and channels of communication, to drive customer engagement, interface with CRM and feed the work planning.
narrative:
## Context

We use a legacy application, on-prem, unsupported that cover VOIP.

## Problem

It doesn't support where the business needs to be

## Proposal

We want to implement a full CCaaS platform that covers all digital platforms and channels of communication, to drive customer engagement, interface with CRM and feed the work planning.
